affected_existing_reqs.diff_summary: Defines strict save_document and smart_search schemas; new requirement adds client-profile/model-size conformance around those schemas.
Defines eight-tool parity; new requirement extends parity with model-facing self-routing descriptions, portable schema subset, and golden profile fixtures.
smart_search ranking and bounded output semantics remain DOC-owned.
Redaction policy governs corrective errors, diagnostics, and result envelopes.
Broken-link lifecycle policy remains DOC-owned and MCP-inert; agent-facing tools must expose only redacted diagnostics and no reconciliation controls.
Canonical link edge status plus diagnostic_code is the data contract that smart_search diagnostics and link filters must respect.

rationale: The request asks how many agent clients and model sizes can reliably use the new tools, and adds a broken-link policy concern. This is a cross-client MCP contract and conformance concern layered over DOC-owned storage, ranking, and link diagnostic behavior.
